friction_points.issue: The enterprise sync engine utilizes an async base class (`BaseConnector`) returning `HealthCheckResult`, whereas the public SDK defines a synchronous `Connector` base class returning booleans and `SyncResult` models[cite: 1, 2].
friction_points.resolution: Created an SDK-compliant implementation while maintaining adapter stubs for the unified regression harness.

friction_points.issue: `describe_config()` and `describe_credentials()` require verbose JSON schema envelopes (`type`, `properties`, `required`)[cite: 2].
friction_points.resolution: Implemented explicit schema dictionaries matching the SDK specification.

recommendations: Unify the legacy sync engine and public SDK base classes to eliminate interface drift[cite: 1, 2].
Provide schema helper utilities in the SDK to reduce configuration boilerplate.
